{"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-k53h","title":"[review] project-LICHEN-worker6-z22y: responder uses plaintext instead of ciphertext for TH_4","description":"In verify_message_3 (edhoc.rs:1345), the responder computes TH_4 from `pending.plaintext` (the decrypted message_3) instead of the ciphertext. Per RFC 9528, TH_4 = H(TH_3, CIPHERTEXT_3). Using plaintext produces a different hash than the initiator computes, breaking OSCORE context derivation.

**Fix needed:**
1. Add a `ciphertext` field to `PendingMessage3` struct (or store raw msg3)
2. Pass the raw ciphertext (not `pending.plaintext`) to `transcript_4` in `finish_process_message_3`
3. Add interop test verifying initiator and responder derive the same TH_4","status":"open","priority":1,"issue_type":"bug","owner":"agent@lichen-project.dev","created_at":"2026-07-24T18:15:20.335010497Z","created_by":"AI Agent","updated_at":"2026-07-24T18:15:20.335010497Z"}
